kitchens.title: Ibikoni
kitchens.noKitchens: Nta magataraga. Ongeraho igataraga yawe rya mbere.
kitchens.noKitchensDesc: Kora igikoni cyawe cya mbere kugira ngo ucunge ububiko, menu n'ibyakiriwe.
kitchens.createHeroSub: Aho ukorera ucunga ububiko, menu n'ibyakiriwe.
kitchens.archiveDialogMessage: Iki gikoni kizahishwa aho ukorera. Ushobora kukigarura nyuma.
kitchens.photoPermissionBody: Emera kamera cyangwa amafoto kugira ngo wongereho ifoto y'igikoni.
kitchens.photoSource: Fata ifoto cyangwa uhitemo imwe mu mafoto yawe.
kitchens.currencyLockedHint: Ibiciro bishingiye ku ifaranga. Koresha "Guhindura ifaranga" hasi kugira ngo ubihindure.

errors.closingTime: Isaha yo gufunga igomba kuba nyuma yo gufungura, urugero: 22:00

currencyChange.title: Guhindura ifaranga
currencyChange.entrySubtitle: Ubu ni {{currency}} · hindura ibiciro cyangwa izina ry'ifaranga
currencyChange.entryHint: Ubanza kubona uko bizaba mbere y'uko hagira igihinduka

modeHelp.convert: Buri giciro cyo kuri menu n'ikiguzi cy'ibikoresho bihindurwa ku gipimo kimwe cy'ivunjisha, kigaragara hasi n'itariki yacyo.
modeHelp.relabel: Koresha ibi niba ibiciro byawe byanditswe mu ifaranga ritari ryo. Imibare ntihinduka; ifaranga ni ryo rihinduka gusa.

currencyChange.previewError: Ntibyashobotse kwerekana uko bizaba. Reba interineti wongere ugerageze.
currencyChange.rateUnavailable: Nta gipimo cy'ivunjisha gihari cyo mu minsi 3 ishize. Ongera ugerageze nyuma, cyangwa uhindure izina gusa.
currencyChange.relabelPrecision: Hari ibiciro bifite ibice birenze ibyo {{currency}} yemera. Banza ubikosore, cyangwa uhindure ibiciro.
currencyChange.historyBody: Ibyagurishijwe {{sales}}, komande {{orders}}, ibyanditswe muri stock {{stock}} n'ibyakiriwe {{deliveries}} bigumana ifaranga ryabyo rya mbere. Raporo ivanga amakuru ya kera n'amashya izerekana amafaranga yombi.
currencyChange.priceStepReset: Uburyo bwo kuzengurutsa ibiciro busubira ku bwa ifaranga rishya.
currencyChange.pastRecords: Ibyagurishijwe, komande, ibyakiriwe n'ibya stock byashize ntibihinduka.
currencyChange.rateChanged: Igipimo cy'ivunjisha cyahindutse. Reba uko bizaba ubu wongere wemeze.
currencyChange.convertOff: Guhindura ibiciro mu yandi mafaranga ntibirashoboka ku bikoni byo mu gihugu cyawe. Ushobora guhindura izina ry'ifaranga gusa, cyangwa ugakomeza ibiciro mu ifaranga ryawe.
